eyebrow: Quorum and majority -- two separate checks
code:
Quorum check:
  total_votes_cast >= quorum_threshold
  quorum = 400,000; votes cast = 450,000 -> quorum met

Majority check:
  for_votes / (for_votes + against_votes) > 50%
  for = 300,000, against = 150,000
  300,000 / 450,000 = 66.7% -> majority met

Both must pass -- either failing defeats the proposal
caption: A 95% For vote means nothing if almost nobody showed up to vote.
